emails.subject_line_b: Tampa homepage roof estimator for Buddy
emails.body_text:
Hey Buddy,

I was looking at buddysroofing.com and noticed your homepage has zero quote form — every Book Online button sends Tampa homeowners off-page to a 7-field contact form with no ballpark pricing.

A lot of Florida homeowners close the tab rather than fill out 7 fields blind.

So I built a working 30-second Tampa Roof Estimator in your crimson-and-slate Buddy's Roofing branding. It shows hurricane-rated shingle, metal, and tile ranges right on the homepage before asking for a name and number.

Mind if I send over the live preview link?

— {{sender_name}}

{{sender_address}} | {{unsubscribe_line}}

objection_handlers.objection: We already get steady business from referrals and repeat customers.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: That 37-year word-of-mouth reputation is gold — and even referrals still visit buddysroofing.com on their phone before calling. Right now there's no form on your homepage. Adding a 30-second estimator simply captures the Tampa homeowners already checking you out online who prefer seeing a ballpark before picking up the phone.

objection_handlers.objection: Florida Building Code and wind mitigation requirements vary too much for online quotes.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: 100% agree — this never gives a binding bid. It gives an honest Tampa Bay hurricane-code range with a clear on-site inspection disclaimer so $6,000 tire-kickers filter themselves out, while qualified homeowners understand why a direct-hire Florida-code roof runs $15k–$45k+.

objection_handlers.objection: Why pay $750 setup + $149/mo when we already have a /contact.html page?
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Your /contact.html page is an off-page 7-field form with no pricing transparency, which leaks mobile visitors. This tool sits directly on your homepage in Buddy's crimson-and-slate colors, flags active leaks and storm jobs into your ASAP slot for your 24/7 crews, updates Tampa pricing quarterly, and one extra closed replacement covers 3+ years.

objection_handlers.objection: I don't want anyone breaking or redesigning our current website.
objection_handlers.reframe_response: Zero redesign required. It's a single 28 KB vanilla JavaScript script wrapped in Shadow DOM isolation, so it cannot touch or alter a single pixel of your existing styles. Your web guy pastes one line in 5 minutes — and we'll even send over the fix for your oversized 1395x1117 PNG logo for free.

objection_handlers.objection: Email me the numbers and I'll look it over with Crystal and the office.
